name: Search for Tyranis
summary: At Thunder Axe Fortress, Dalinda Malem waits to learn what became of Tyranis. Orcs killed their guards and servants before bringing the siblings there. Tyranis tried to speak with his captors, and Dalinda asks you to find him and return once you know his fate.

sections.title: A Brother Taken
sections.body: Orcs killed every guard and servant before dragging Dalinda and Tyranis to Thunder Axe Fortress. She expected them to die at once, but their captors had other designs. Tyranis tried speaking with the orcs, perhaps hoping his arcane learning would impress them. Dalinda cannot say why. She will not escape until she knows his fate, so she asks you to find him and return. He is in the building left of the fortress entrance.

sections.title: Dalinda's Fear
sections.body: Dalinda fears Tyranis will seek the Burning Blade's secrets and join them if he can. Power has always drawn him, as magic draws those it seduces. To Dalinda's people, even studying such things is a grave crime. She doubts she could face her family knowing her brother had toyed with that danger.

sections.title: What Dalinda Learns
sections.body: When you return, Dalinda calls what happened terrible but necessary. If your hand had not done it, someone from her own people would have. She asks you to pardon her if her thanks sounds hollow. Now that she knows Tyranis's fate, she is ready to escape and will accept your help if you are still willing.

faq.answer: Tyranis Malem is Dalinda's brother. He spoke to their captors, perhaps hoping his arcane learning would impress them. Dalinda says magic's power has always drawn him.

faq.q: Why does Dalinda refuse to leave yet?
faq.answer: Dalinda refuses to leave until she knows what happened to her brother. She asks you to find him and return once his fate is known.

faq.q: What happened to the guards and servants?
faq.answer: The orcs killed all the guards and servants, then took Dalinda and Tyranis alive with other designs.
Tyranis is at Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace, in the building on the left as you enter.
This follows the third part of Vahlarriel's Search, where Vahlarriel sent you to find Dalinda.
